arm_design: ablation: ImageNet init, the merged bank with every render row removed (the N persons' crops at the same oversampled count, the selection crops as val), 15 epochs; no N = 0 cell (nothing to train on)

design.encoder: tools/train_level_classifier.py on render_bank from ImageNet (--require-pretrained), 40 epochs, lr 3e-4, --augment 2, --uint8-resident, seed 0, tag renderonly: the film-free encoder every cell fine-tunes
design.score: tools/rigor_fixes.py a5-rows --ctx test_ctx (the v9 val films of all three corpora) --kmax 4 --seed 0; tools/eval_gate.py inside a5-rows on the encoder + head chain
design.persons: tools/rigor_fixes.patient_key; TEST = v9 val persons; SELECTION = fixed 15 % (<= 100) of v9 train persons; POOL = the rest, nested by seed
design.analogue: the C-ArmLSpine naming curve (tools/indomain_name_fill.py): v9 init that never saw a C-arm frame + N C-arm cases merged 1:1 with the v9 base sample; here: render-only init that never saw a film + N film persons merged 1:1 with the render base sample

render_bank.note: v9 rows whose source is a rendered CT (no film row): the film-free encoder's bank

test_ctx.note: the v9 val films of nhanes / buu_full / csxa: the fixed TEST persons of every cell
